transcript: The espresso machine in the kitchen is broken again. The pump makes a grinding noise and no water comes through the group head at all. I already descaled it twice this month and it did not help, so I think the pump itself has finally given up and we should just replace the whole unit rather than keep repairing it. Completely different topic now. My sister is getting married in Vermont in October and I have not booked a flight yet. The prices go up sharply after August and I keep putting it off because I cannot decide whether to fly into Burlington or drive up from Boston with the rest of the family.

The retry logic needs to only fire on timeouts. Right now it backs off on any error class at all, which means a 400 gets retried three times before we give up. On a different note, I noticed the history pane is slow to open once you get past a few hundred entries.
